title: The Lord's Judgment on Israel through the Prophet Amos
description: The Lord speaks against Israel and reminds them that He has chosen them from among all the families of the earth, and therefore will punish them for their sins. Through a series of images – the lion that roars, the bird in the snare, the horn that sounds the alarm – the prophet Amos shows that no disaster happens without the Lord’s will, and that the Lord does nothing without revealing it to his servants the prophets. Amos announces that an enemy will surround the land, tear down Samaria’s strength, and plunder the palaces. The altars in Bethel will be destroyed, and both winter houses and summer houses, ivory houses and splendid dwellings will perish as punishment for the people’s violence and injustice.
